parameters.content:
## Phase 1 — scrape + listing + QA (stops here)

**START:** Paste **Product URL** → scrape → AI listing → QA.

**On QA PASS:** sheet **Status** = `READY_FOR_CLIENT` — workflow **stops**. Client fills **Price**, **Inventory quantity**, **Sizes** (confirm/override), then **Approve** (Phase 2).

**On QA FAIL:** Status = `NEEDS_REVIEW`.

Sheet: `url_input` / `url_input.csv` | Match column: **Product URL**

## Sheet columns

### Phase 1 — automation writes:
Title, Description, image URL, Sizes, Colors, competitor price, QA Status, AI Score

### Phase 1 — client waits for Status = `READY_FOR_CLIENT` then fills:
| Price | Your sell price |
| Inventory quantity | Stock to list |
| Sizes / Colors | Confirm or override scrape |
| Approve | `YES` when ready (Phase 2) |

### YOU start with:
| Product URL | Triggers scrape |

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const u = $json['Product image URL'] || $json.validated_image_url || ''; if (!u || /\.html(\?|$|#)/i.test(u)) throw new Error('No product image URL — scrape missed image. Re-run scrape or paste Product image URL manually.'); return u; })() }}
